title: The variable-length stem structures in three-soliton resonance of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili II equation
summary: The stem structure is a localized feature that arises during high-order soliton interactions, connecting the vertices of two V-shaped waveforms. The interaction of resonant 3-solitons is accompanied by soliton reconnection phenomena, characterized by the disappearance and reconnection of stem structures. This paper investigates variable-length stem structures in resonant 3-soliton solutions of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili II (KPII) equation, focusing on both 2-resonant and 3-resonant 3-soliton cases.
